violations.text: Portable coffee service area does not have a hand-washing sink that is conveniently located and/or readily accessible. Hand-washing sinks must be located to allow convenient use by employees in food preparation, food dispensing, and ware-washing areas. Establishment to submit construction application for newly built barista counter. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

Raw animal foods were not stored properly to prevent cross-contamination (raw shelled eggs over raw beef brisket). Except when combined as ingredients, different types of raw animal foods must be separated from each other during storage by using separate equipment or arranging each type of food in equipment so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026
Pickled Jalapenos were observed held past 7 days. Foods were voluntarily disposed of during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

Portable coffee service area does not have a 3 bay sink to wash, rinse and sanitize equipment and utensils that is conveniently located. Establishment to submit construction application for newly built barista counter. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

The floor and wall junctures in the meat cutting room do not have coving. The floor and wall junctures must be coved and closed to no larger than 1/32nd of an inch. New Violation. Correct By: 12/20/2026
No person certified in food safety was present as needed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 04/16/2025
Establishment does not have an individual with the Rhode Island Food Safety Manager license. Application provided to PIC. New Violation. Correct By: 05/28/2025
The handwashing sinks in the main kitchen and in meat cutting room are lacking notification signage. New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2025
Caramelized onions and housemade relish were observed held past 7 days. Foods were voluntarily disposed of during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 04/16/2025
The walls near the 3 bay sink in meat cutting room and the coving in the meat cutting room were observed in poor repair. New Violation. Correct By: 07/16/2025
Lightbulbs under the kitchen hood were observed missing and/or nonfunctional during time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 04/30/2025
